requirement.evidence: The allowable annual increase will not be permitted, if the dwelling is not in substantial compliance and/or if the landlord has not met the registration requirements as specified in this subsection 19:2-9.8.
requirement.note: The 12-month window, the 4% cap, the irrelevance of tenant or owner changes, and the substantial-compliance and registration conditions are all stated on the page. The advice to check registration with the Office of Rent Control is only a practical suggestion.

key_value.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
key_value.note: The page states the 4% cap, and the 12-month period appears in the preceding paragraph.

effective_date.evidence: The Rent Control Ordinance was amended on September 05, 2017.
effective_date.note: The 2017-09-05 date is the amendment date, shown in the ordinance citation (Ord. 6 PSF-A(S), 9-5-17). The page does not say that the 4% cap took effect on that date.

status.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
status.note: The page presents the cap as current law. The 2020 moratorium was rescinded on September 18, 2023.

coverage.note: The coverage field on the card is empty.
